scope.historical: 11/21-24 research replay of actual published-family full probability vectors, chronological outcome dates
scope.today: 11/25 two-source matched payout, same 75 forecasts reproduced up to top8 from original distribution, partial day
scope.oracle: Known-winner, known-ordered-pair and known-unordered-trio diagnostics filter the original ranking using actual outcome one item at a time. They do not model a viable forecast, and these outcomes never enter a forecast.
scope.within_budget_sets: A correct first slot, ordered first pair, unordered first pair, unordered podium trio and exact ordered trio are counted from the same capped tickets. Pair and unordered trio are distinct headroom concepts.
